# kayjs-mail

> Mail for kay apps: SMTP configured from typed environment variables, mails written as `.kay` components rendered to html and text, an outbox in development and tests instead of a real server, and sending through kay's queue with retries. It works from kay pages, actions and jobs, and from a plain Elysia app.

## Topics

The rest is split by topic, each file read whole with one command:

- [Setup, environment, writing and sending mails](llms/writing-and-sending.md): the setup, the environment variables, writing a mail and sending it
- [The contact form, testing, development and kayjs-auth](llms/contact-form-and-testing.md): the contact form action, testing mails, the development outbox, other transports, and the mails kayjs-auth sends
